item.title: [github_trending] ayghri/i-have-adhd
item.description: i-have-adhd is a GitHub skill/plugin that makes coding agents surface answers directly instead of burying them in verbose output. It's designed to be ADHD-friendly, though no ADHD diagnosis is needed. The repo offers multilingual READMEs, including Simplified Chinese, and installs by pasting a snippet into your CLI prompt.

item.title: [producthunt] Switch
item.description: Switch is a Product Hunt listing that aims to bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams, and Discord, letting teams operate agents inside the chat apps they already use. The listing is only one sentence for now, with no setup or compatibility details revealed.

item.title: [juejin] Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
item.description: The author looks back on a year with Cursor, praising its in-editor Tab completion and Agent mode, and says he built a functional WeChat mini-program with zero hand-written code. After Cursor switched from fixed pricing to unpredictable usage-based billing in April 2026, his company moved its China region to OpenAI Codex; the article offers his impressions after about half a month with Codex.

item.title: [zhihu] 女子旧手机号二次放号后支付宝被哈啰盗刷 6551 元，平台仅补 200 元，这合理吗？暴露了哪些问题？
item.description: A Zhihu question describes a user whose old phone number was reassigned to someone else and whose Alipay account was then drained of 6,551 yuan through 哈啰, with only 200 yuan offered as compensation. It raises the question of who is responsible when recycled numbers, re-verification and payment risk controls fail. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

item.title: [36kr] 苹果把iPhone折起来，顺手补交了AI答卷
item.description: A 36Kr piece looks at Apple folding the iPhone into a new form factor while also catching up on its AI story, tying the hardware move and the AI effort into one narrative. It should interest readers tracking Apple's product roadmap and the pace at which its AI features actually ship. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

item.title: [infoq] 9 月 20 日杭州，FDE 现场解码：企业 AI 真正卡在技术，还是组织？
item.description: On September 20, 模力工场 is hosting a 50-person FDE meetup at Hangzhou Cloud Valley Center, framed around whether enterprise AI really stalls on technology or on organization. FDE stands for Forward Deployed Engineer, and the two talks plus a roundtable cover the jump from demo to production: data access, system integration, permissions, evaluation, human handoff, and whether custom work can turn into reusable product. It targets people pushing AI projects inside companies.

item.title: [v2ex] [iPhone] 现在有没有什么靠谱的野路子能把国内的 eSIM 写进外版 iPhone ？
item.description: A V2EX user asks whether any reliable grey-market method exists for writing a mainland-China eSIM profile onto an overseas iPhone. He had found a seller offering the service on a second-hand trading platform, but by the time he wanted to discuss it for a new phone, the account and listing had vanished and similar sellers could no longer be found. It's relevant to anyone weighing eSIM restrictions on China-version versus overseas iPhone models.

item.title: [v2ex] [OpenAI] Codex $200 Pro plan 暂停供应
item.description: A V2EX post reports that Tibo confirmed on X that OpenAI has paused supply of the $200 Codex Pro plan. The poster happened to subscribe to Pro the same day and says access isn't cut off for now, but expects Tibo's manual usage resets to become much rarer or disappear entirely. It's aimed at developers tracking Codex subscription limits and throttling policy.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 把你写的故事变成有声音的动画短片： C2Anime
item.description: C2Anime turns stories and novel excerpts into animated shorts with visuals, dialogue and sound, and its homepage already hosts finished samples such as The Last Leaf and The Monkey's Paw. Watching samples is free while rendering costs credits, so it targets people with no animation experience who want to turn their writing into video.

item.title: [producthunt] Mastra Factory
item.description: Mastra Factory is a Product Hunt launch whose tagline reads "From issue to production, run by agents." The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the tagline aren't available, so anyone tracking agent-driven development workflows should check it directly.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] AI 私人宠物医生
item.description: Built by an owner of three cats, the AI private vet (agent.pet-pedia.org) keeps per-pet health records covering species, breed, age, weight, medical history, medication and allergies, so it gives continuous triage-style advice instead of one-off answers. Google login is supported with five free questions a day, aimed at owners who need a first assessment when clinics are closed.

item.title: [36kr] 8点1氪丨苹果发布首款折叠屏iPhone Duo：售价15999元起；支付宝账户被哈啰打车盗刷6551元，哈啰客服称最多赔200；DeepSeek备战科创板IPO

The entry is a headline roundup with no further details provided.

item.description: An open-source collection of GPT Image 2.5 prompts (wangrunlin/awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts) gathers 24 cases across 6 use categories, each with Chinese and English text, the original author's post, required inputs and observation time. Data lives in JSON and auto-generates the README and bilingual pages, though the maintainer notes the cases haven't been independently regenerated for verification.

item.title: [juejin] 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
item.description: A developer shipped a WeChat mini-game, "Happy Link-Up", spending about two months of spare time and roughly $6 (WeChat certification plus Tencent Cloud OSS). The stack is pixi.js@6, matter-js, Vite and Supabase, with Claude Code writing the code and gpt, gemini and Doubao generating art. The write-up lists 19 mini-game pitfalls, a reusable Claude Code prompt workflow and the full cost breakdown, useful for solo devs building with AI.

item.title: [v2ex] [Apple] 下单苹果手表 12 代
item.description: A user ordered the Apple Watch Series 12, saying their Series 8 is down to 87% battery health and roughly 15 hours of runtime, while the new model adds about 8 more hours. They plan to try a Milanese loop for the first time, and were drawn to a keynote moment where the watch warned a drummer that their body wasn't holding up. Delivery is expected on the 18th.

They note the iPad Pro lets buyers choose nano-texture, which they returned, while the iPhone Duo ships it across the lineup.

item.description: EgressKit is an Apache-2.0 tool that imports a Clash/Mihomo subscription, picks out its VLESS nodes, checks their egress IPs, and exposes them behind a single HTTP proxy endpoint. Clients pick an exit policy through the proxy username: rotate hands out the least recently used IP, while sticky.task-01 pins one session to the same exit. It targets anyone scraping or running browser automation who needs rotating or fixed exit IPs; it starts with one Docker command and bundles Mihomo plus a web cons

item.title: [v2ex] [问与答] 微信 Wayland 环境下分辨率问题
item.description: If WeChat renders too small on a Wayland Linux desktop, the fix shared in this thread is to launch it with the Qt xcb backend and a raised scale factor: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb QT_SCALE_FACTOR=1.25 /usr/bin/wechat. That's the whole answer — an environment-variable workaround — so it mainly helps Linux users hitting similar HiDPI scaling problems.

item.title: [producthunt] Kombai Gallery
item.description: Kombai Gallery is a curated library of more than 20,000 UI designs, explicitly positioned for both AI agents and humans. It gives agent-based front-end tooling a large pool of reference interfaces while also serving people who want ready-to-browse design examples. Developers exploring AI-assisted UI workflows should look it over.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] PicLocation - 上传照片， AI 告诉你它在哪拍的
item.description: PicLocation is a free web tool that skips EXIF entirely and instead has a vision model read landmarks, architectural style, vegetation, signage and terrain to guess where a photo was taken, returning GPS coordinates, city, country and a confidence score on a map. Guests get two analyses a day; uploads accept JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8MB and are deleted after seven days. item.title: [infoq] Meta Muse突袭：人手一台AI虚拟机，全天候干活！扎克伯格想让 AI 自己“挣回饭钱”
item.description: Meta launched Muse on September 8, pitching it as a personal AI agent rather than a chatbot: give it a goal and it breaks the work down, opens web pages, fills forms and calls external apps, handling email, scheduling, bookings or even negotiating a bill. Each user gets a separate Muse Secure VM in Meta's cloud, so tasks keep running after the app is closed and stop only for sensitive approvals. It's US-only for now via a standalone app, web and WhatsApp.

item.description: At QCon Shanghai on October 22–24, iQIYI's Dr. Lu Xiangju will present Nado PRO's Script Space, a multi-agent system for screenwriting in which a main chat dialog drives several agents that combine free-form interaction with professional script workflows and quantitative evaluation, so writing and assessment happen side by side. The talk covers plot consistency, dialogue polish and removing the telltale AI flavor, plus pitfalls like agent conflicts and context drift. It suits developers working

item.title: [infoq] Tether：在 iOS 与 Linux 桌面电脑之间实现类似 Apple Continuity 的体验
item.description: Developer Zack Bartel released Tether, an open-source project that brings Apple Continuity-style features to Linux desktops: iMessage and SMS, clipboard sync, file transfer, iOS notifications and automatic one-time passcode filling. It relies on mutual TLS over the local network plus a clean-room C++ Bluetooth stack that talks directly to iOS, avoiding the usual Mac-based relay, and ships under the MIT license. One-time codes still need the custom Zen Browser and Betterbird extensions.

item.title: [infoq] Copilot 代码审查功能已登陆 Azure Repos，按审查次数计费
item.description: Microsoft has made GitHub Copilot code review generally available for Azure Repos, dropping the sign-up requirement it imposed in June. The feature posts review comments on pull requests and is billed per review through the linked Azure subscription, with token usage converted to GitHub AI credits at one point per cent and costs appearing in Azure Cost Management within 48 hours, now tagged by Azure DevOps project for cost attribution. Its Remote MCP Server also reached GA this month.
